Alex — thanks for the usage file and the context. Quick summary up front: we can flatten your unit economics substantially with a staged commit and a short bridge term while you stabilize the longer prompts.

Highlights (executive):
- Current 90d run-rate: ~$142K/mo token spend (external tokens + embeddings mix).
- 6-month commit option (Tier B): projected average monthly bill = ~$98K/mo (~30% effective savings) if usage remains within 120% of current run-rate.
- 3-month bridge (month-by-month credit): $20K one-time credit applied across 3 months to offset model migration risk.

Performance notes:
- If you need strict p95 latency <= 250ms for gen endpoints we recommend locking to our low-latency variants (m18-lowlat) for the checkpointed flows; that increases token cost by ~6% vs baseline but reduces tail latency.
- For long-context summarization we suggest enabling prefix caching and a 4k quantization profile that preserves output quality; our tests show <2% quality delta with ~1.8x token-cost improvement for repeated prefixes.

Attached: detailed ROI workbook with month-by-month scenarios and a short sample trace (lyric_commit_proposal_v2.xlsx).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm appetite for a 3-month bridge + 6-month commit (we can provide DocuSign/PO templates).
2) If yes, we lock m18-lowlat on renewal lanes that need p95 SLAs and provide a one-page rollout checklist for the engineering team.

If helpful I can schedule a quick 30-minute sync with Ben (covers pricing/discount authority) and Monica (CS/ops for rollout).

Best,
Kimberly Park
